verses.original: שִׁ֥יר הַֽמַּעֲל֗וֹת לְדָ֫וִ֥ד הִנֵּ֣ה מַה־ טּ֭וֹב וּמַה־ נָּעִ֑ים שֶׁ֖בֶת אַחִ֣ים גַּם־ יָֽחַד׃
verses.transliteration: šîr ham·ma·‘ă·lō·wṯ lə·ḏā·wiḏ hin·nêh mah- ṭō·wḇ ū·mah- nā·‘îm še·ḇeṯ ’a·ḥîm gam- yā·ḥaḏ
verses.literal: A song of ascents Of David Behold how good and pleasant it is when brothers live together in harmony

verses.original: כַּשֶּׁ֤מֶן הַטּ֨וֹב׀ עַל־ הָרֹ֗אשׁ יֹרֵ֗ד עַֽל־ הַזָּקָ֥ן זְקַֽן־ אַהֲרֹ֑ן שֶׁ֝יֹּרֵ֗ד עַל־ פִּ֥י מִדּוֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: kaš·še·men haṭ·ṭō·wḇ ‘al- hā·rōš yō·rêḏ ‘al- haz·zā·qān zə·qan- ’a·hă·rōn šey·yō·rēd̲ ‘al- pî mid·dō·w·ṯāw
verses.literal: It is like fine oil on the head running down on the beard running down Aaron’s beard over the collar of his robes

verses.original: כְּטַל־ חֶרְמ֗וֹן שֶׁיֹּרֵד֮ עַל־ הַרְרֵ֪י צִ֫יּ֥וֹן כִּ֤י שָׁ֨ם׀ צִוָּ֣ה יְ֭הוָה אֶת־ הַבְּרָכָ֑ה חַ֝יִּ֗ים עַד־ הָעוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kə·ṭal- ḥer·mō·wn še·yō·rêḏ ‘al- har·rê ṣî·yō·wn kî šām ṣiw·wāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- hab·bə·rā·ḵāh ḥay·yîm ‘aḏ- hā·‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: It is like the dew of Hermon falling on the mountains of Zion For there the LORD has bestowed the blessing of life forevermore . . .
